title: Create domain correct smoothed parameter snapshot engine
description:
Create Source/Parameters/ParameterSnapshot.h and Source/Parameters/ParameterSnapshot.cpp providing a real-time-safe snapshot of the smoothed current values of all continuous parameters, plus the current discrete choices. Apply domain-correct smoothing per the binding rules: linear juce::SmoothedValue for dB values (input_trim, mid_amount, drive, level, pick_attack); multiplicative juce::SmoothedValue for strictly positive frequencies (tight_cut, mid_freq, tone). Provide prepare(sampleRate) that sizes ramp times and allocates any smoothing state (called from prepareToPlay), a per-block/per-sample advance to retrieve smoothed values, and setter/target methods driven from raw parameter pointers. Discrete parameters (voicing_mode, oversampling, auto_gain) are carried as plain current values (crossfade/topology switching handled elsewhere), NOT smoothed here. The advance/get path must be allocation-free, lock-free, and must not construct strings or call the GUI (real-time safe). Header declares the ParameterSnapshot type; cpp implements it.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h and Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h (for parameter set)
- The binding smoothing rules above (linear dB vs multiplicative frequency).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: dB parameters (input_trim, mid_amount, drive, level, pick_attack) use linear juce::SmoothedValue and frequency parameters (tight_cut, mid_freq, tone) use multiplicative juce::SmoothedValue
A prepare(sampleRate) method exists for allocation during prepareToPlay and the value-advance path performs no heap allocation, locking, or string construction
voicing_mode, oversampling, and auto_gain are carried as discrete current values and are not smoothed as continuous SmoothedValue
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate heap memory, lock, or construct strings on the real-time value-advance path
